domain_id.description: Domain ID or fully qualified domain name (e.g. "example.com")

error_code_if_disabled.description: SMTP error code when alias is disabled: 250, 421, or 550

has_imap.description: Enable or disable IMAP storage for the alias

has_pgp.description: Enable OpenPGP encryption for IMAP/POP3 storage

has_recipient_verification.description: Require recipients to click an email verification link

is_enabled.description: Whether the alias is enabled for email routing

max_quota.description: Maximum storage quota for this alias (e.g. "1GB")

public_key.description: OpenPGP public key in ASCII Armor format

recipients.description: Comma or newline separated email addresses to forward to

vacation_responder_end_date.description: Vacation responder end date (MM/DD/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD)

vacation_responder_message.description: Message body for the vacation responder (plaintext)

vacation_responder_start_date.description: Vacation responder start date (MM/DD/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD)

vacation_responder_subject.description: Subject line for the vacation responder (plaintext)
